why: User accepted all V8 donor05 sequential-group diagnostics, including the power/ground probe.
method: Use donor05 sequential $TERINPUT/$TEROUTPUT-or-$TERGROUND/REALIND/wire groups, donor05 suffix step extension, one donor-derived $TERPOWER->$TEROUTPUT(V0) bridge, and G0 right endpoints as $TERGROUND.

cases.description: Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: A single resistor connected directly between the power terminal and ground.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Four resistors connected end-to-end in one path from power to ground.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Four resistors side-by-side, each connected from power to ground.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: A series resistor feeding a parallel group, then returning to ground.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Two resistors in series between power and ground with one midpoint tap.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Five series resistors creating four voltage tapping points.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Five parallel resistors across power and ground to split current.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Three resistors end-to-end forming a closed triangle between V0, D1, and G0.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Three resistors sharing a central node, with outer nodes at power, ground, and an output terminal.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: A delta network and a star network side-by-side for comparison.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Four-resistor diamond with power at top, ground at bottom, and side measurement nodes.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Wheatstone bridge with equal ratios on both sides, plus high-value bridge measurement resistor.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Wheatstone bridge with unequal side ratios and a bridge measurement resistor.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: Two vertical series branches with a fifth resistor bridging their middle joints.
Power/ground inductor version of requested topology: A four-step R-2R ladder using 1k and 2k resistor values.

notes: These files use terminal-label topology and short endpoint wires.
Powered inductor endpoints remain ordinary $TERINPUT(V0), connected through the donor-derived V0 power bridge.
Grounded right endpoints are emitted as $TERGROUND(G0).
Stop at the first fatal Proteus error and report the exact case id and error text.
